changelog: - **The page no longer scrolls under the app.** When the model list was longer than the window — the Early MMO example in a tall window — a mouse wheel over the Properties panel scrolled the whole page: the menu bar left the top and empty space opened below the status bar, until Ctrl+Home. The list's screen-reader separators (the heard comma between a name and its value) reached past the list; the list now contains them, and only the list scrolls.
